title: McFarlane Platinum Edition Dc Multiverse Effigy Green Lantern Figure
descriptionText:
New In Hand!

Introducing the McFarlane Platinum Edition DC Multiverse Effigy Green Lantern CHASE Figure. This highly collectible action figure is a must-have for any Green Lantern fan. With its stunning design and attention to detail, it's sure to be a standout addition to your collection.

Featuring the iconic superhero in his classic green and black uniform, this figure is made by McFarlane Toys, a trusted brand in the industry. It's an action figure type with a Chase feature, making it a unique and sought-after item. Perfect for display or play, this Green Lantern figure is a great addition to any toy collection.
